decisions.why: Peripheral SFA self-expanding stent graft; examples cite 'Chronic Total Sfa Occlusions' and 'In Stent Restenosis', confirming use for peripheral arterial disease intervention.

Peripheral balloon-expandable stent graft; examples include 'Reconstructing Aortic Bifurcation', 'Treating Calcified Lesion', 'Severe Claudication' — confirming peripheral vascular intervention for SFA/iliac disease.

Heparin-bonded EPTFE peripheral vascular bypass graft; examples cite 'Comparison Of Propaten Heparin Bonded', 'Heparin Bonded Eptfe Femoropopliteal Bypass Grafts', and 'Below Knee Data' — confirming peripheral vascular bypass use.
Rapid-sealing vascular graft designed for haemodialysis arteriovenous access; examples are 'Value Summary' and 'Physician Resources' — a haemodialysis access consumable.
Propaten heparin-bonded graft designed for paediatric AV shunt/graft for haemodialysis access; a paediatric variant of dialysis access grafts.
Stretch vascular graft designed for haemodialysis vascular access; a consumable for dialysis AV access creation.
Vascular access introducer sheath for peripheral vascular intervention procedures; fits vascular access sheaths used in angiography and intervention.
Gore-Tex suture for dental and oral surgical use; classified as a dental consumable.
Peripheral self-expanding vascular stent; MRI Safety example confirms this is a peripheral vascular stent device used in peripheral intervention.
